Team —

As we close the month I need a quick, tight sweep to lock the Dec forecast and assemble the leadership packet. Please see the asks below and confirm ownership by EOD Tuesday (Dec 8):

1) Data extracts (owner: Marcus)
   - Pull a stage-level export for all open opportunities and closed-won in 2026 Q4; include fields: deal id, account, ARR, stage, close probability, opp owner, last activity.
   - Attach to this thread or drop in the Drive folder. I attached a small template to standardize columns.

2) Stage confirmations (owners: Laura + Karthik)
   - Each deal owner should validate current stage and expected close month. Mark any deals that are stalled or on hold.
   - Exclude paused/paused-for-legal deals unless the owner explicitly requests inclusion (call out in notes).

3) Leadership packet (owner: Grace)
   - Collate top 20 deals (by ARR) with a 2-line status, blockers, and required exec asks. Leadership packet will be compiled Monday Dec 14.

4) Audit trail / evidence (all)
   - For any commit we include, attach a recent activity snapshot (last 30 days), pricing approval emails, or DocuSign counters if available.

Attachments: forecast_extract_template.csv, leadership_packet_instructions.pdf

Timeline: EOD Tue Dec 8 for raw extracts; Fri Dec 11 for owner confirmations; final packet assembled Mon Dec 14.

If anyone expects issues hitting those dates, flag now so we can adjust scope.

Thanks —
Rishi

Agree with Laura that we should be selective on what counts as a commit for the leadership packet. My recommendation:

- Include deals in stages: Contract Sent, Legal Review (if there is a signed SOW PDF or DocuSign present), Verbal Commit.
- Exclude "Final Proposal" unless the rep confirms an exec ask or a pricing exception is in flight.

For the data extract, use this filter to avoid noise:
- opportunity_close_month >= 2026-12 AND (stage IN ('Contract Sent','Legal Review','Verbal Commit','Closed Won'))

I'll push a sanitized SQL snippet to the Drive in case Marcus wants to run the query directly.

Karthik
Sr. Manager, Revenue Strategy
